<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
	<data source="caption"></data>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>	
        <data source="editor"><label>Editor(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="contributors"><label>Contributor(s)</label></data>				
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>First released</label></data>
        <data source="intl release"><label>International releases</label></data>	
        <data source="pages"><label>Pages</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>	
        <data source="issue"><label>Issue #</label></data>
        <data source="featured"><label>Featured</label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>			
        <data source="prev"><label>Previous</label><default>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=prev|label=Issue}}</default><format>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=prev|label=Issue|value={{{prev|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="next"><label>Next</label><default>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=next|label=Issue}}</default><format>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=next|label=Issue|value={{{next|}}}}}</format></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:ReferenceMagazine|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|editor|contributors|publisher|release date|intl release|pages|issue|featured|series|optional=caption,no_year_check,unlicensed,prev,next|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|template_name=ReferenceMagazine|misc=1|unlicensed={{{unlicensed|}}}}}<noinclude>[[category:Media infoboxes]]{{Clear}}

==Usage==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. If a field is unknown, or does not apply, simply leave it empty.

<pre>{{Top|real}}
{{ReferenceMagazine
|image=
|title=
|editor=
|contributors=
|publisher=
|release date=
|intl release=
|pages=
|issue=
|featured=
|series=
}}</pre>
